_readme: Labeled evaluation corpus for MatchCraft. Every document is synthetic and describes
no real person, employer, or contact detail; all e-mail addresses use the reserved
.test TLD and all employers, schools, and products are invented.
Labels state what a competent human reviewer would say the job requires and what the
resume genuinely evidences. They are NOT predictions of the current parser's output.
Where a label and the implementation disagree, the label is the claim under test.
'matches_any_of' exists only to absorb legitimate surface-form differences (the parser
surfaces catalog skills as bare canonical names such as 'PostgreSQL'). It never
changes the semantic claim of a label.

cases.notes: CHALLENGE: clean, conventional baseline - standard 'Required/Preferred Qualifications/Responsibilities' headings, chronological resume, vocabulary shared by both documents. BAND: strong because every required item and two of three preferred items are evidenced in contextual sentences, with only Kubernetes missing.
